ss_noshow_policy_001.content: No-Show Re-engagement Policy. Tier 1 (0 prior no-shows): same-day friendly re-book email, no task. Tier 2 (1 prior no-show): re-book email plus create a 2-day follow-up task for the host; log a contact note. Tier 3 (2+ prior no-shows): no automatic email; create a high-priority task for the host to call, log a contact note, and post the account to the #sales-at-risk Slack channel for AE review. All outreach must use the approved re-book email template and reference the original demo time.

rebook_email_template.content: Approved re-book template 'Demo No-Show v3': Subject 'Sorry we missed you - let's find a new time'. Body references the missed demo date/time, offers a self-serve Calendly link, and is signed by the assigned host. Approved by Marketing Ops 2025-11-02.
